rebuttal_or_critique: The headline CPI inflation at 7.44% is significantly above the upper tolerance band, and the 11.51% food inflation, compounded by a 5% monsoon deficit, poses a clear risk to the durability of price stability. While I acknowledge the moderation in core inflation to 4.90%, the persistence of food price shocks necessitates a cautious approach. I maintain that the current repo rate of 6.50% is appropriate to balance the need for anchoring inflation expectations with the requirement to support the 7.80% GVA growth. I am not in favor of a neutral stance while inflation remains this elevated, as it would send an incorrect signal regarding our commitment to the 4% target.
